title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Pengalokasian Dua Ribu Delapan Ratus Tiga Puluh Sembilan Dolar Tiga Puluh Satu Sen dalam Mata Uang Amerika Serikat untuk Pembayaran Berbagai Biaya Pemerintah Provinsi Benguet
title.ms: Akta Mengeluarkan Dua Ribu Lapan Ratus Tiga Puluh Sembilan Dolar Tiga Puluh Satu Sen dalam Wang Amerika Syarikat bagi Bayaran Pelbagai Perbelanjaan Kerajaan Wilayah Benguet

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

text.en:
The following sums in money of the United States are hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the
Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for expenses of the provincial government of Benguet:
(a) For two typewriters, two hundred and fifty dollars;
(b) For stationery, constables' badges, blank books, stamped paper, receipts, strong boxes and officials'
seals, necessary to carry out the provisions of "An Act providing for the establishing of local civil
governments in the townships of the Province of Benguet," enacted November twenty-second,
nineteen hundred, and of "An Act providing for the establishment of a civil government in the
Province of Benguet," enacted November twenty-third, nineteen hundred, and for transportation of the
same, seven hundred dollars;
(c) For actual expense's of necessary traveling on official business by the provincial governor, the
provincial secretary, and the provincial inspector, hereby authorized, at a rale not exceeding two
dollars per day for each official, two hundred dollars;
(d) For salaries of two clerks, hereby authorized, at ten dollars each per month, from January first to
July first, nineteen and one, one hundred and twenty dollars; for salaries of two clerks, hereby
authorized, at seventy-five dollars each per month, from March first to July first, nineteen hundred
and one, six hundred dollars; for two Igorrote messengers, hereby authorized, at, four dollars each per
month, from March first to July first, nineteen hundred and one, thirty-two dollars;
Total, seven hundred and fifty-two dollars;
(e) For rent of government offices, at thirty-seven dollars and fifty cents per month, from January first
to July first, nineteen hundred and one, two hundred and twenty-five dollars;

(f) For the salary of the provincial governor, from December eighteenth, nineteen hundred, until April
first, nineteen hundred and one, four hundred and twenty-seven dollars and thirty-nine cents;
(g) For the salary of the provincial secretary from December eighteenth, nineteen hundred, until April
first, nineteen hundred and one, two hundred and eighty-four dollars and ninety-two cents.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this appropriation bill, the passage of the same
is hereby expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the
Commission in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 28, 1901.
